stories.title: Suspended North Wales Police officer denies rape and sexual assault charges
stories.summary: A suspended North Wales Police officer has pleaded not guilty to rape and three counts of sexual assault at Mold Crown Court. PC Ashley Dodge, 35, denied all the charges at a plea hearing on Friday 27 November. The charges relate to alleged offences against a woman while he was off duty, North Wales Police

stories.title: £10.5m upgrade under way at Mold wastewater treatment works
stories.summary: Welsh Water is spending £10.5 million on upgrading Mold’s wastewater treatment works. The works serves 8,000 homes and businesses in the town. stories.title: Power cut hits part of Sandycroft with supply due back by 1.30pm
stories.summary: Update, 12:55 27 Nov: SP Energy Networks now expects power to be restored by 3pm. Part of Sandycroft is without power this morning after an unplanned power cut, with SP Energy Networks aiming to restore supplies by 1.24pm. The fault was reported at 11.24am and affects 39 postcodes: CH5 2PN, CH5 3PG, CH5 2QL, CH5

stories.title: Power cut hits part of Holywell with supply due back by 3pm
stories.summary: Update, 12:20 27 Nov: SP Energy Networks now expects power to be restored by 7pm. Part of Holywell is without power this morning after an unplanned power cut, with SP Energy Networks aiming to restore supplies by 3pm. The fault was reported at 10.47am and affects seven postcodes: CH8 7AP, CH8 7AR, CH8 7AJ, CH8

stories.title: Announcements do not get people to work: MS demands dates for £20m Flintshire bus plan
stories.summary: The First Minister has said improved bus links to Deeside Industrial Park will move into implementation by the end of the 2027-28 financial year.
